text: As a Physics Educator, I use Typeless AI daily for notes, emails, articles, social media posts, and AI prompts. The speech-to-text accuracy is excellent, and the AI doesn't just transcribe—it intelligently fixes grammar, punctuation, and sentence structure to produce polished writing. The voice editing and rewriting features are incredibly useful and save a lot of time. Works seamlessly across Android, iPhone, Windows, and Mac. One of the best productivity tools I have used. Highly recommended!
